    f = plan['corrected_prerequisite_family']
    family_check(f)
    seal_pin = checked_pin(plan['corrected_prerequisite_seal'])
    need(under(seal_pin['path'], f['root']) and seal_pin in f['files'], 'Corrected source seal belongs to complete pinned family')

    need(seal['whole_members_including_this_seal'] == f['members'], 'Whole corrected prerequisite membership including seal')
    expected = {key(p['path']): p for p in f['files'] if key(p['path']) != key(seal_pin['path'])}
    rows = {key(p['path']): {k: p[k] for k in ('path', 'bytes', 'sha256')} for p in seal['files']}
    need(rows == expected, 'Complete corrected source seal rows, no unpinned family member')
    need(set(plan['corrected_runtime_sources']) == set(ROOT_SOURCE_NAMES), 'Exactly three corrected runtime source roles')
    for row in plan['corrected_runtime_sources'].values():
        checked_pin(row)
        need(row in f['files'], 'Every corrected runtime source in accepted source family')
    return f

formulas.complete_raw_Source:
def validate_full_Source_acceptance(assembly_plan, adopter_source=None):
    """Validate closed Source review DATA; no staging, adoption or phase grant."""
    receipt_pin = checked_pin(assembly_plan['full_Source_acceptance'])
    accepted = read_manual_data(receipt_pin)
    exact_fields = {'schema', 'Source_credit', 'author', 'decision', 'Root_acceptance', 'destinations', 'source_files', 'reviewed_assembler_source', 'reviewed_adopter_source', 'Source_families', 'Root_review_evidence', 'complete_Source_review_contracts', 'Source_staging_authority', 'DATA_adoption_authority', 'runtime_authority', 'phase_authority', 'actual_candidate', 'actual_runtime', 'actual_gate', 'actual_T0', 'actual_F', 'actual_API_terminal'}
    need(isinstance(accepted, dict) and set(accepted) == exact_fields, 'Exact full fresh-scope Source acceptance receipt fields')
    need(accepted['schema'] == 'type1011_Root_fresh_scope_Source_acceptance_v1' and type(accepted['Source_credit']) is int and accepted['Source_credit'] == 0 and accepted['author'] == 'Root' and accepted['decision'] == 'accepted' and accepted['Root_acceptance'] is True, 'Separate exact Root full-Source acceptance only')
    destinations = {'D03': str(D03), 'F4': str(F4), 'OBS03': str(OBS), 'adopters': str(ADOPTERS)}
    need(accepted['destinations'] == assembly_plan['destinations'] == destinations, 'Full-Source acceptance binds exact fresh literal destinations')
    need(set(assembly_plan['source_files']) == set(DRAFT) and len(DRAFT) == 9 and accepted['source_files'] == assembly_plan['source_files'], 'Exact complete nine-role Source pin map')
    need(accepted['reviewed_assembler_source'] == assembly_plan['assembler_reviewed_TEXT'], 'Full-Source receipt binds independently selected assembler TEXT')
    if adopter_source is not None:
        need(accepted['reviewed_adopter_source'] == adopter_source, 'Full-Source receipt binds independently selected adopter TEXT')
    need(all(accepted[k] is False for k in ('Source_staging_authority', 'DATA_adoption_authority', 'runtime_authority', 'phase_authority')), 'Source review confers no staging, DATA adoption, runtime or phase authority')
    need(all(accepted[k] is None for k in ('actual_candidate', 'actual_runtime', 'actual_gate', 'actual_T0', 'actual_F', 'actual_API_terminal')), 'Source review contains no candidate, runtime, gate, clock, F or terminal fact')
    closure = {}
    def add(row, allow_receipt=False):
        need(isinstance(row, dict) and set(row) == {'path', 'bytes', 'sha256'} and isinstance(row['path'], str) and type(row['bytes']) is int and row['bytes'] >= 0 and isinstance(row['sha256'], str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', row['sha256']), 'Exact closed full-Source pin shape')
        checked_pin(row)
        need(not any(under(row['path'], root) for root in (D03, F4, OBS, ADOPTERS)), 'Full-Source acceptance inputs stay outside all prospective output roots')
        k = key(row['path'])
        need(allow_receipt or k != key(receipt_pin['path']), 'Acceptance receipt cannot pin itself through a family or review graph')
        need(k not in closure or closure[k] == row, 'One exact current full-Source pin per canonical path')
        closure[k] = row
        return k
    add(receipt_pin, allow_receipt=True)
    sources = [*accepted['source_files'].values(), accepted['reviewed_assembler_source'], accepted['reviewed_adopter_source']]
    source_keys = {add(p) for p in sources}
    need(len(source_keys) == 11, 'Nine role Sources and two separately selected helper Sources have distinct exact paths')
    families = accepted['Source_families']
    need(isinstance(families, list) and families and len({key(f['root']) for f in families}) == len(families), 'Complete unique immutable full-Source families required')
    family_pins = {}
    source_seals = {}
    for f in families:
        need(isinstance(f, dict) and set(f) == {'root', 'files', 'members'} and isinstance(f['files'], list) and f['files'], 'Exact whole immutable Source family contract')
        need(not any(under(f['root'], root) or under(root, f['root']) for root in (D03, F4, OBS, ADOPTERS)), 'Whole Source families cannot overlap prospective output roots')
        family_check(f)
        contains_source = any(key(p['path']) in source_keys for p in f['files'])
        seals = []
        for p in f['files']:
            k = add(p)
            need(not (Path(p['path']).stat().st_mode & stat.S_IWRITE), 'Every selected full-Source family file is readonly')
            need(k not in family_pins or family_pins[k] == p, 'Overlapping Source families agree on complete current pins')
            family_pins[k] = p
            name = Path(p['path']).name.casefold()
            if contains_source and ('manifest' in name or 'receipt' in name or 'seal' in name):
                source_seals[k] = p
                seals.append(name)
        if contains_source:
            need(any('manifest' in n for n in seals) and any('receipt' in n or 'seal' in n for n in seals), 'Source-containing families include their complete closed manifest and receipt or seal')
    need(all(family_pins.get(key(p['path'])) == p for p in sources), 'Every exact role/assembler/adopter Source belongs to complete immutable Source families')
    evidence = accepted['Root_review_evidence']
    need(isinstance(evidence, list) and evidence, 'Complete separately pinned Root and independent peer Source review evidence')
    evidence_keys = [add(p) for p in evidence]
    need(len(evidence_keys) == len(set(evidence_keys)) and all(family_pins.get(key(p['path'])) == p for p in evidence), 'Every unique selected Source review artifact belongs to complete immutable families')
    contracts = accepted['complete_Source_review_contracts']
    need(isinstance(contracts, list) and len(contracts) >= 2, 'Full separate Root and independent peer Source review contracts required')
    contract_fields = {'report', 'checks_key', 'check_count', 'opening_key', 'closing_key', 'pin_count', 'review_passed_key', 'DATA_checks_passed_key', 'blockers_key'}
    selector_names = ('checks_key', 'opening_key', 'closing_key', 'review_passed_key', 'DATA_checks_passed_key', 'blockers_key')
    report_keys = set()
    reviewed_pins = {}
    for contract in contracts:
        need(isinstance(contract, dict) and set(contract) == contract_fields, 'Exact full Source review-contract fields')
        selectors = [contract[k] for k in selector_names]
        need(all(isinstance(s, list) and len(s) == 1 and isinstance(s[0], str) and s[0] for s in selectors) and len({s[0] for s in selectors}) == 6, 'Six distinct canonical singleton-list Source review selectors')
        report_key = add(contract['report'])
        need(report_key in evidence_keys and contract['report'] in evidence and report_key not in report_keys, 'Every independent complete report is unique and exactly selected in Root review evidence')
        report_keys.add(report_key)
        report = read_manual_data(contract['report'])
        need(isinstance(report, dict) and type(report.get('Source_credit')) is int and report['Source_credit'] == 0, 'Full Source report has exact integer Source credit zero')
        def field(selector):
            need(selector[0] in report, 'Complete selected Source review field is present')
            return report[selector[0]]
        checks = field(contract['checks_key'])
        opening = field(contract['opening_key'])
        closing = field(contract['closing_key'])
        need(type(contract['check_count']) is int and contract['check_count'] > 0 and isinstance(checks, list) and len(checks) == contract['check_count'], 'Exact complete Source review predicate list length')
        need(all(isinstance(c, dict) and c.get('passed') is True for c in checks), 'Every complete Root/peer Source review predicate passes')

formulas.complete_raw_Source:
def check_authority(plan, plan_pin, authorization_pin):
    need(plan['schema'] == 'type1011_Root_DATA_adopter_plan_v2' and plan['Source_credit'] == 0 and plan['Root_acceptance'] is False and plan['Root_adoption'] is False and plan['actual_execution_event'] is None, 'Unadopted independently selected adopter plan')
    need('authorization' not in plan and 'authorization_sha256' not in plan, 'Authorization is separate from plan; no plan/authorization hash cycle')
    reviewed = checked_pin(plan['reviewed_generator_TEXT'])
    execution = checked_pin(plan['selected_generator_execution_source'])
    need(pin(__file__) == execution, 'Actual generator source independently selected')
    need(pin(sys.executable) == checked_pin(plan['selected_generator_python']), 'Actual selected Python host file for DATA assembly')
    same_content(reviewed, execution)
    family_check(plan['reviewed_generator_family'])
    need(reviewed in plan['reviewed_generator_family']['files'], 'Reviewed generator belongs to complete immutable TEXT family')
    family_check(plan['reviewed_assembler_family'])
    checked_pin(plan['reviewed_assembler_source'])
    need(plan['reviewed_assembler_source'] in plan['reviewed_assembler_family']['files'], 'Reviewed assembler belongs to complete independently selected family')
    source_family(plan)
    accepted = read(plan['corrected_source_acceptance'])
    need(accepted['schema'] == 'type1011_Root_corrected_source_acceptance_v1' and accepted['Source_credit'] == 0 and accepted['author'] == 'Root' and accepted['decision'] == 'accepted', 'Separate genuine Root corrected-source review receipt')
    need(accepted['corrected_prerequisite_seal'] == plan['corrected_prerequisite_seal'] and accepted['corrected_runtime_sources'] == plan['corrected_runtime_sources'], 'Root accepted these exact corrected source bytes')
    need(accepted['runtime_qualification'] is False and accepted['actual_execution_event'] is None, 'Source acceptance confers no fabricated runtime fact')
    need(isinstance(accepted['Root_review_evidence'], list) and accepted['Root_review_evidence'], 'Concrete independently pinned Root/peer source review evidence')
    for p in accepted['Root_review_evidence']:
        checked_pin(p)
    _, _, _, _, assembly_plan = input_seal(plan)
    validate_full_Source_acceptance(assembly_plan, reviewed)
    authorization = read(authorization_pin)
    need(authorization['schema'] == 'type1011_Root_DATA_adoption_authorization_v2' and authorization['Source_credit'] == 0 and authorization['author'] == 'Root' and authorization['decision'] == 'accepted', 'Separate Root DATA-adoption authorization receipt')
    bindings = {'plan': plan_pin, 'unadopted_Root_seal': plan['unadopted_Root_seal'], 'corrected_source_acceptance': plan['corrected_source_acceptance'], 'full_Source_acceptance': plan['full_Source_acceptance'], 'reviewed_generator_TEXT': reviewed, 'selected_generator_execution_source': execution, 'selected_generator_python': plan['selected_generator_python'], 'reviewed_assembler_source': plan['reviewed_assembler_source'], 'adopted_root': plan['adopted_root']}
    need(all(authorization[k] == v for k, v in bindings.items()), 'Root authorization exact source/plan/old-seal/target bindings')
    need(authorization['allow_DATA_adoption'] is True and authorization['allow_dispatch'] is False and authorization['actual_execution_event'] is None, 'Only separately authorized DATA adoption, never dispatch or runtime observation')
    return accepted, authorization

formulas.complete_raw_Source:
def input_seal(plan):
    sp = checked_pin(plan['unadopted_Root_seal'])
    seal = read(sp)
    need(seal['schema'] == 'type1011_root_prerequisites_seal_v1' and seal['Source_credit'] == 0 and seal['Root_acceptance'] is False, 'Exact unadopted assembler Root DATA seal')
    root = canonical(seal['root'])
    need(root.parent == ADOPTERS and Path(sp['path']).parent == root, 'Exact existing unadopted generation under selected adopter parent')
    f = {'root': str(root), 'members': seal['members'], 'files': [*seal['files'], sp]}
    family_check(f)

    need(S['schema'] == 'type1011_root_prerequisites_selection_v1' and S['Source_credit'] == 0 and S['Root_acceptance'] is False, 'Unadopted complete Root selection')
    need(set(S) == set(ROOT_SELECTION_KEYS), 'Exact reviewed Root selection field set')
    need(S['phase'] == plan['phase'] and S['dispatch_label'] == plan['dispatch_label'] and S['phase'] in PHASES, 'Root plan phase and dispatch label')
    need(re.fullmatch('[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}', S['dispatch_label']) and root.name == S['dispatch_label'], 'Fresh assembler label/root identity')
    need(S['original_arguments'] == [S['phase']] and key(S['root_output_directory']) == key(OBS / 'root_observer' / S['dispatch_label']), 'Original phase argv and Root output remain unchanged')
    need(key(plan['adopted_root']) == key(ADOPTERS / (S['dispatch_label'] + '_adopted01')), 'Exact fresh adoption target distinct from unadopted generation')
    need(not Path(plan['adopted_root']).exists(), 'No adopted generation overwrite/retry')
    need(set(S['sources']) == set(ROOT_SOURCE_NAMES), 'Three exact runtime roles')
    for role, source in S['sources'].items():
        checked_pin(source)
        need(source in seal['files'] and key(source['path']) == key(root / ROOT_SOURCE_NAMES[role]), 'Runtime source location belongs to sealed unadopted graph')
        same_content(source, plan['corrected_runtime_sources'][role])
    need(S['fixture_selection'] in seal['files'] and S['phase_inventory_contract'] in seal['files'] and S['native_slice_contract'] in seal['files'], 'Complete current selection/contract graph belongs to sealed family')
    s = read(S['fixture_selection'])
    need(set(s) == set(FIXTURE_SELECTION_KEYS) and s['schema'] == 'type1011_dependency_guard_selection_v1' and s['Source_credit'] == 0 and s['Root_acceptance'] is False and s['Root_adopted_fields'] is False and s['proposal_only'] is True and s['actual_execution_event'] is None, 'Exact unadopted complete fixture selection fields')
    need(s['external_job_image_policy'] in seal['files'], 'Selected image policy belongs to sealed unadopted graph')
    assembly_plan = read(s['assembly_plan'])
    need(assembly_plan['schema'] == 'type1011_F4D03_assembly_plan_v2' and assembly_plan['full_Source_acceptance'] == plan['full_Source_acceptance'], 'Exact v2 assembly/adopter full-Source acceptance binding')
    validate_full_Source_acceptance(assembly_plan, plan['reviewed_generator_TEXT'])
    need(assembly_plan['assembler_reviewed_TEXT'] == plan['reviewed_assembler_source'] and assembly_plan['phase'] == S['phase'] and assembly_plan['label'] == S['dispatch_label'], 'Unadopted graph derives from the exact reviewed assembler and phase plan')
    checked_pin(assembly_plan['assembler_execution_source'])
    same_content(assembly_plan['assembler_execution_source'], plan['reviewed_assembler_source'])
    need(assembly_plan['Root_source_files'] == plan['corrected_runtime_sources'] and assembly_plan['selected_prerequisite_family_seal'] == plan['corrected_prerequisite_seal'], 'Exact corrected runtime package selected by original assembler')
    completion = read(pin(root / 'assembly_completion.DATA.json'))
    need(completion['schema'] == 'type1011_D03_phase_assembly_completion_DATA_v1' and completion['Source_credit'] == 0 and completion['Root_acceptance'] is False and completion['Root_adoption'] is False and completion['actual_execution_event'] is None, 'Unadopted assembler completion remains DATA only')
    need(completion['counts'] == {'files': len(s['files']), 'scopes': len(s['scopes']), 'memberships': len(s['memberships'])}, 'Exact full unadopted selection counts')
    need(completion['base_seal'] == plan['D03_base_seal'] and completion['plan'] == s['assembly_plan'] and completion['phase'] == S['phase'] and completion['label'] == S['dispatch_label'] and completion['candidate_executed'] is False and completion['F4_created_by_assembler'] is False, 'Complete unadopted assembly source/base/phase graph')
    base = load_base({'current_D03_base_seal': plan['D03_base_seal']})
    need(s['materialization_draft'] == base['draft'] and key(base['draft']) == key(D03 / 'selected_draftF4'), 'Unchanged complete selected D03 materialization draft')
    base_rows = {key(row['original']['path']): row for row in base['files']}
    all_rows = {key(row['original']['path']): row for row in s['files']}
    need(all(all_rows.get(key(p['path']), {}).get('original') == p for p in (s['assembly_plan'], assembly_plan['assembler_execution_source'], plan['reviewed_assembler_source'])), 'Complete exact original assembler and plan source graph')
    need(len(base_rows) == len(base['files']) and len(all_rows) == len(s['files']) and all(all_rows.get(k) == row for k, row in base_rows.items()), 'Every full D03 original/frozen pair preserved exactly')
    need(s['scopes'][:len(base['scopes'])] == base['scopes'], 'Every complete immutable D03 scope preserved exactly')
    need([r for r in s['memberships'] if r['category'] in {x['category'] for x in base['scopes']}] == base['memberships'], 'Every immutable D03 membership preserved exactly')
    legacy = read(assembly_plan['legacy_selection_reference'])
    need((len(legacy['files']), len(legacy['memberships']), len(legacy['scopes'])) == (13239, 16380, 58), 'Complete original reviewed legacy reference counts')
    need(all(base_rows.get(key(row['original']['path']), {}).get('original') == row['original'] for row in legacy['files']), 'Every original reference pin retained in full immutable D03 closure')
    original_scope = next(x for x in base['scopes'] if x['category'] == 'DATA_legacy_complete_original_pin_table')
    need(original_scope['kind'] == 'explicit' and {key(p) for p in original_scope['paths']} == {key(r['original']['path']) for r in legacy['files']}, 'Exact complete 13239-original DATA scope')
    return f, S, s, base, assembly_plan

formulas.complete_raw_Source:
def baseline(S, s, assembly_plan, adopted):
    recheck_base(s)
    originals = {key(row['original']['path']): row['original'] for row in s['files']}
    full_acceptance, full_source_pins = validate_full_Source_acceptance(assembly_plan)
    need(all(originals.get(key(p['path'])) == p for p in full_source_pins), 'Entire nine-role Source acceptance and review closure remains in full original inventory')
    need(all(f in S['immutable_families'] for f in full_acceptance['Source_families']), 'Every whole accepted Source/review family retained in current selection')
    probe_original = checked_pin(assembly_plan['source_files']['probe'])
    probe_draft = pin(D03 / 'selected_draftF4' / DRAFT['probe'])
    same_content(probe_draft, probe_original)
    need(s['external_child_timeout_seconds'] == 540 and s['external_timeout_seconds'] == 600, 'Original fixed outer/child deadlines')
    need({x['category'] for x in s['scopes']} == set(S['required_scope_categories']), 'Full exact selected scope set')
    for p in s['selected_code']:
        checked_pin(p)
        need(originals.get(key(p['path'])) == p, 'Every current selected code pin belongs to the full original closure')
    expected_code = {key(D03 / 'selected_entry_sources' / name) for name in ENTRY.values()} | {key(D03 / 'selected_draftF4' / DRAFT[role]) for role in STAGED}
    for role, name in ENTRY.items():
        current = pin(D03 / 'selected_entry_sources' / name)
        checked_pin(assembly_plan['source_files'][role])
        same_content(current, assembly_plan['source_files'][role])
    for role, name in STAGED.items():
        checked_pin(assembly_plan['source_files'][role])
        same_content(pin(D03 / 'selected_draftF4' / DRAFT[role]), assembly_plan['source_files'][role])
        if S['phase'] != 'prepare':
            same_content(pin(F4 / name), assembly_plan['source_files'][role])
    if S['phase'] != 'prepare':
        expected_code |= {key(F4 / name) for name in (*STAGED.values(), 'query_helper.py')}
    need({key(p['path']) for p in s['selected_code']} == expected_code, 'Exact existing code set and reviewed source content, no substituted code path')
    for k in ('private_environment', 'private_external_environment', 'external_driver', 'external_bootstrap', 'external_powershell_host', 'external_job_supervisor', 'external_job_policy', 'external_job_image_policy'):
        checked_pin(s[k])
    need(s['private_external_environment'] == S['external_environment'] and s['external_powershell_host'] == S['platform_host'], 'Exact shared external environment/host')
    need(S['platform_host'] == assembly_plan['powershell_host'] and S['verifier_python'] == assembly_plan['python_executable'], 'Original exact selected observer host files')
    need(s['package_modules'] == assembly_plan['package_modules'] and s['capstone_native'] == assembly_plan['capstone_native'], 'Unchanged complete package entry/native pins')
    expected_metadata = {'external_driver': D03 / 'selected_entry_sources' / ENTRY['driver'], 'external_bootstrap': D03 / 'selected_entry_sources' / ENTRY['bootstrap'], 'external_job_supervisor': D03 / 'selected_entry_sources' / ENTRY['supervisor'], 'private_environment': D03 / 'selected_private_profiles/Python_roles.json', 'private_external_environment': D03 / 'selected_private_profiles/external_role.json', 'external_job_policy': D03 / 'selected_private_profiles/job_policy.json'}
    need(all(key(s[k]['path']) == key(path) for k, path in expected_metadata.items()), 'Exact unchanged entry/profile metadata locations')
    need(S['selected_guard'] == pin(D03 / 'selected_entry_sources' / ENTRY['guard']) and S['selected_guard'] in s['selected_code'] and S['selected_program'] in s['selected_code'], 'Unique exact selected guard/program source pins')
    needed_originals = [*S['sources'].values(), S['phase_inventory_contract'], S['native_slice_contract'], s['external_job_image_policy'], S['verifier_python'], *[s[k] for k in (*expected_metadata, 'external_powershell_host')]]
    need(all(originals.get(key(p['path'])) == p for p in needed_originals), 'Complete runtime/contract/metadata original pins after relocation')
    checked_pin(S['verifier_python'])
    for f in S['immutable_families']:
        family_check(f)
    for p in S['additional_current_pins']:
        checked_pin(p)
    profiles = read(s['private_environment'])
    external = read(s['private_external_environment'])
    need(set(profiles) == {'root_process', 'recipe_children'} and (len(profiles['root_process']), len(profiles['recipe_children']), len(external)) == (11, 13, 15), 'Unchanged full private profiles')
    need(profiles == read(assembly_plan['profiles']['Python_roles.json']) and external == read(assembly_plan['profiles']['external_role.json']), 'Private maps exactly equal original reviewed assembler inputs')
    family_check(assembly_plan['copied_BIN'])
    need(len(assembly_plan['copied_BIN']['files']) == 73 and len(assembly_plan['copied_BIN']['members']) == 74, 'Exact copied BIN73/74')
    for category in ('MSVC_hostx64_x86', 'literal_MSVC_bin_allfiles'):
        scope = next(x for x in s['scopes'] if x['category'] == category)
        need(key(scope['root']) == key(assembly_plan['copied_BIN']['root']) and scope['kind'] == 'tree' and scope['recursive'] is True and scope['extensions'] == [] and not scope['excluded_part'], 'Both unchanged complete copied-BIN execution scopes')
    whole(s['empty_cache_prefix'], [])
    contract = read(S['phase_inventory_contract'])
    need(contract['schema'] == 'type1011_root_phase_inventory_v1' and contract['Source_credit'] == 0 and contract['Root_acceptance'] is adopted and contract['phase'] == S['phase'] and contract['label'] == S['dispatch_label'] and key(contract['fixture_root']) == key(F4), 'Exact phase/baseline contract')
    if S['phase'] != 'prepare':
        probe_actual = pin(F4 / 'type1011_probe.cpp')
        same_content(probe_actual, probe_original)
        need(probe_actual in contract['fixture_before_files'] and originals.get(key(probe_actual['path'])) == probe_actual, 'Current prepared probe belongs to full before inventory and original closure')
    if S['phase'] == 'prepare':
        need(not F4.exists() and contract['fixture_before_files'] == [] and contract['fixture_before_members'] == [], 'Absent F4 prepare baseline; never materialize it here')
        expected_program = D03 / 'selected_draftF4/type1011_recipe.py.txt'
        need(len(s['selected_code']) == 8 and not any(under(p['path'], F4) for p in s['selected_code']), 'Eight existing D03 code pins only before prepare')
        copies, dependencies = prepare_contract(assembly_plan, {'draft': s['materialization_draft'], 'files': s['files']})
        need(contract['prepare_copy_map'] == copies and contract['prepare_dependency_rows'] == dependencies, 'Complete exact current selected prepare copy/dependency contract')
    else:
        family_check({'root': str(F4), 'members': contract['fixture_before_members'], 'files': contract['fixture_before_files']})
        expected_program = F4 / 'recipe.py'
        names = {'recipe.py', 'gate.py', 'independent_code_reader.py', 'independent_recorded_reader.py', 'query_helper.py'}
        need(len(s['selected_code']) == 13 and {key(p['path']) for p in s['selected_code'] if under(p['path'], F4)} == {key(F4 / n) for n in names}, 'All five current F4 code pins after prepare')
        query = pin(F4 / 'query_helper.py')
        same_content(query, selected_prepare_query({'draft': s['materialization_draft']}))
        need(query in contract['fixture_before_files'], 'Current query belongs to exact full F4 baseline')
    need(len({key(p['path']) for p in s['selected_code']}) == len(s['selected_code']) and key(S['selected_program']['path']) == key(expected_program), 'Unique exact phase code/program selection')
    checked_pin(S['selected_program'])
    expected_empty = [str(OBS / x) for x in ('temp', 'coordination', 'selected_empty_cache')]
    need(contract['must_remain_empty_roots'] == expected_empty and key(s['empty_cache_prefix']) == key(OBS / 'selected_empty_cache'), 'Exact private empty roots')
    for root in expected_empty:
        whole(root, [])
    need(key(s['external_records_directory']) == key(OBS / 'external_records'), 'Exact unchanged external record root')
    family_check({'root': s['external_records_directory'], 'members': contract['external_before_members'], 'files': contract['external_before_files']})
    whole(S['root_output_directory'], [])
    native = read(S['native_slice_contract'])
    need(native['schema'] == 'type1011_original_native_disk_slices_v1' and native['Root_acceptance'] is adopted and native['Source_credit'] == 0, 'Exact native DATA contract schema/adoption state')
    verify_native({'original_game_PE': native['original_game_PE'], 'native_slice_contract_TEMPLATE': S['native_slice_contract'], 'native_frozen_slices': [r['frozen_bytes'] for r in native['slices']]})
    policy = read(s['external_job_image_policy'])
    need(policy['schema'] == 'type1011_selected_job_images_v1' and policy['Source_credit'] == 0 and policy['Root_acceptance'] is adopted and policy['selected_program'] == S['selected_program']['path'] and policy['original_arguments'] == S['original_arguments'] and policy['dispatch_label'] == S['dispatch_label'], 'Exact phase-specific image policy')
    roles = tuple(row['role'] for row in policy['allowed_images'])
    wanted = IMAGE_ROLES + (('fresh_produced_probe',) if S['phase'] == 'launch' else ())
    need(roles == wanted and len({key(r['file']['path']) for r in policy['allowed_images']}) == len(wanted), 'Exact six image roles, plus fresh probe only for launch')
    need(policy['allowed_images'][:6] == assembly_plan['exact_selected_images'], 'Unchanged exact base image pins')
    for row in policy['allowed_images']:
        checked_pin(row['file'])
    if S['phase'] == 'launch':
        p = policy['fresh_launch_authorization']
        checked_pin(p)
        need(key(p['path']) == key(F4 / 'Root_linked_manual_gate_receipt.json'), 'Only current F4 linked Root receipt')
        receipt = read(p)
        need(receipt['author'] == 'Root' and receipt['decision'] == 'accepted' and list(receipt['inputs']) == ['executable', 'gate', 'coverage', 'objects', 'provenance', 'launch_ast'] and receipt['inputs']['executable'] == policy['allowed_images'][-1]['file'], 'Fresh linked Root six-input executable identity')
    else:
        need(policy['fresh_launch_authorization'] is None, 'No inherited or non-launch probe admission')
    checked_pin(S['combined_Root_transport_contract'])
    need(S['combined_Root_transport_contract'] == assembly_plan['Root_transport_contract'], 'Unchanged exact reviewed transport contract pin')
    return contract, native, policy

formulas.complete_raw_Source:
def adopt(plan, plan_pin, authorization_pin, old_family, S, s, base, assembly_plan, source_acceptance):
    full_acceptance, full_source_pins = validate_full_Source_acceptance(assembly_plan, plan['reviewed_generator_TEXT'])
    old_root = Path(old_family['root'])
    target = canonical(plan['adopted_root'])
    need(not target.exists(), 'Fresh exact adopted generation required')
    mkdir(target)
    image_pin = change_contract(s['external_job_image_policy'], target / 'selected_job_images.json', 'type1011_selected_job_images_v1')
    phase_pin = change_contract(S['phase_inventory_contract'], target / 'phase_inventory.json', 'type1011_root_phase_inventory_v1')
    native_pin = change_contract(S['native_slice_contract'], target / 'native_slice_contract.json', 'type1011_original_native_disk_slices_v1')
    new_sources = {role: copy(S['sources'][role], target / ROOT_SOURCE_NAMES[role]) for role in ROOT_SOURCE_NAMES}
    relocation = {key(S['sources'][r]['path']): new_sources[r] for r in ROOT_SOURCE_NAMES}
    relocation.update({key(S['phase_inventory_contract']['path']): phase_pin, key(S['native_slice_contract']['path']): native_pin, key(s['external_job_image_policy']['path']): image_pin})
    need(len(relocation) == 6, 'Exactly three source and three contract relocations')
    control_inputs = {'generator_reviewed.py.txt': plan['reviewed_generator_TEXT'], 'generator_selected.py': plan['selected_generator_execution_source'], 'adoption_plan.DATA.json': plan_pin, 'Root_DATA_adoption_authorization.json': authorization_pin, 'Root_corrected_source_acceptance.json': plan['corrected_source_acceptance'], 'Root_fresh_scope_Source_acceptance.json': plan['full_Source_acceptance']}
    controls = [copy(p, target / 'control' / name) for name, p in control_inputs.items()]
    templates = []
    need(set(assembly_plan['event_templates']) == EVENT_NAMES, 'Both exact unfilled event templates')
    for name in sorted(EVENT_NAMES):
        selected = pin(old_root / name)
        same_content(selected, assembly_plan['event_templates'][name])
        event = read(selected)
        need(event['schema'] == 'type1011_Root_genuine_API_event_v1' and event['Source_credit'] == 0, 'Unfilled genuine-event template schema')
        need(all(event[k] is None for k in ('Root_observed_genuine_terminal', 'Root_observer_identity', 'actual_tool_name', 'actual_request_id', 'actual_session_id', 'genuine_immediate_terminal_without_session', 'actual_chunk_id', 'actual_raw_API_result', 'observed_root_pid')), 'Never manufacture or copy populated actual API event metadata')
        need(all(all(v is None for v in event[k].values()) for k in ('observed_source', 'Root_seal', 'origin_context')), 'Future event source/seal/origin pins remain unfilled')
        templates.append(copy(selected, target / name))
    base_rows = {key(row['original']['path']): row for row in base['files']}
    old_phase = {key(row['original']['path']): row['original'] for row in s['files'] if key(row['original']['path']) not in base_rows}
    need(set(relocation) <= set(old_phase), 'Every relocated original is a phase input, never an immutable base input')
    new_phase = unique_pins([*old_phase.values(), *relocation.values(), *control_inputs.values(), *controls, *templates, *source_acceptance['Root_review_evidence'], *full_source_pins, plan['selected_generator_python'], plan['unadopted_Root_seal'], plan['corrected_prerequisite_seal'], plan['D03_base_seal']])
    for k in list(new_phase):
        if k in base_rows:
            need(new_phase[k] == base_rows[k]['original'], 'No changed base input admitted by adoption')
            del new_phase[k]
    scopes = []
    replaced_paths = set()
    base_categories = {x['category'] for x in base['scopes']}
    for old_scope in s['scopes']:
        scope = json.loads(json.dumps(old_scope))
        if scope['category'] not in base_categories:
            need(scope['kind'] == 'explicit', 'Only reviewed explicit phase scopes can require relocation')
            new_paths = []
            for path in scope['paths']:
                k = key(path)
                if k in relocation:
                    new_paths.append(relocation[k]['path'])
                    replaced_paths.add(k)
                else:
                    new_paths.append(path)
            scope['paths'] = sorted(new_paths, key=str.casefold)
        scopes.append(scope)
    need(replaced_paths == set(relocation), 'Every affected complete phase scope rebuilt with exact relocated paths')
    scopes.append(explicit('DATA_unadopted_phase_inputs_' + S['dispatch_label'], list(old_phase.values())))
    scopes.append(explicit('Root_current_adoption_inputs_' + S['dispatch_label'], list(new_phase.values())))
    originals = {k: row['original'] for k, row in base_rows.items()}
    originals.update(new_phase)
    memberships = collect_memberships(scopes, originals)
    files = list(base['files']) + freeze(list(new_phase.values()), target / 'frozen_phase_inputs')
    fixture = {k: s[k] for k in FIXTURE_SELECTION_KEYS}
    fixture.update(Root_acceptance=True, Root_adopted_fields=True, proposal_only=False, files=files, scopes=scopes, memberships=memberships, external_job_image_policy=image_pin, authority_boundary='Root separately authorized immutable DATA adoption; no dispatch/API/runtime observation')
    need(fixture['selected_code'] == s['selected_code'] and fixture['materialization_draft'] == s['materialization_draft'] and fixture['actual_execution_event'] is None, 'Code/draft/actual-event fields unchanged')
    # The selections cannot pin themselves or each other recursively. Their
    # complete file pins belong to the final Root seal, written after both.
    fixture_pin = save(target / 'fixture_selection.json', fixture)
    root_selection = {k: S[k] for k in ROOT_SELECTION_KEYS}
    preserved_families = [*S['immutable_families'], old_family, plan['reviewed_generator_family'], plan['reviewed_assembler_family'], *full_acceptance['Source_families']]
    unique_families = {}
    for f in preserved_families:
        k = key(f['root'])
        need(not under(target, f['root']) and not under(f['root'], target), 'No adopted family/ancestor in immutable-family graph')
        need(k not in unique_families or unique_families[k] == f, 'Same immutable root must have identical complete pins')
        unique_families[k] = f
    extra_pins = unique_pins([*S['additional_current_pins'], *control_inputs.values(), *controls, *templates, *source_acceptance['Root_review_evidence'], *full_source_pins, plan['unadopted_Root_seal'], plan['D03_base_seal']])
    root_selection.update(Root_acceptance=True, status='Root-authorized immutable DATA adoption; separate Root dispatch instruction still required', sources=new_sources, fixture_selection=fixture_pin, phase_inventory_contract=phase_pin, native_slice_contract=native_pin, required_scope_categories=[x['category'] for x in scopes], immutable_families=list(unique_families.values()), additional_current_pins=list(extra_pins.values()))
    need(all(root_selection[k] == S[k] for k in ('phase', 'dispatch_label', 'original_arguments', 'selected_program', 'selected_guard', 'root_output_directory', 'working_directory', 'platform_host', 'verifier_python', 'external_environment', 'combined_Root_transport_contract')), 'Every original dispatch/baseline identity and transport field preserved')
    root_pin = save(target / 'Root_selection.json', root_selection)
    save(target / 'adoption_binding.DATA.json', {'schema': 'type1011_Root_DATA_adoption_binding_v1', 'Source_credit': 0, 'Root_acceptance': False, 'actual_execution_event': None, 'Root_authorization_input': authorization_pin, 'corrected_source_acceptance_input': plan['corrected_source_acceptance'], 'plan_input': plan_pin, 'unadopted_seal_input': plan['unadopted_Root_seal'], 'unchanged_D03_base_seal': plan['D03_base_seal'], 'relocation': [{'old_path': k, 'new_pin': p} for k, p in relocation.items()], 'adopted_fixture_selection': fixture_pin, 'adopted_Root_selection': root_pin, 'fixture_row_exclusions_bound_only_by_final_Root_seal': ['fixture_selection.json', 'Root_selection.json', 'adoption_binding.DATA.json', 'Root_seal.json'], 'own_final_seal_hash': None, 'dispatch_executed': False, 'runtime_qualification': False, 'actual_API_terminal_observed': False})
    # Both complete old and new graphs must still match current disk data, and
    # the entire original phase output/external/temp/cache baseline stays exact.
    baseline(S, s, assembly_plan, False)
    baseline(root_selection, fixture, assembly_plan, True)
    family_check(old_family)
    checked_pin(plan_pin)
    checked_pin(authorization_pin)
    checked_pin(plan['corrected_source_acceptance'])
    source_family(plan)
    before_seal = family(target)
    final_seal = save(target / 'Root_seal.json', {'schema': 'type1011_root_prerequisites_seal_v1', 'Source_credit': 0, 'Root_acceptance': True, 'root': str(target), 'selection': root_pin, 'files': before_seal['files'], 'members': sorted(before_seal['members'] + ['Root_seal.json']), 'authority': 'Separate pinned Root authorization permits DATA adoption only. No actual API, process, QPC, runtime, ABI or game fact is issued. Final seal hash is supplied independently in later Root argv.'})
    readonly(target)
    family_check({'root': str(target), 'members': sorted(before_seal['members'] + ['Root_seal.json']), 'files': [*before_seal['files'], final_seal]})
    return final_seal
